rules.source_quote: This facility is applicable for War Bereaved, War Disabled and Attributable Peacetime casualties only.
Reimbursement of interest on loan taken from banks for construction of house to War Bereaved, War Disabled and Attributable Peace time casualties is provided out of AFFD Fund.
rules.note: Loan condition is implicit in the benefit description (subsidy requires an existing loan). Official source: ksb.gov.in/interest-subsidy-on-home-loan.htm (confirmed 2026-11-12).

unresolved: The Rs 1,00,000 loan limit caps the subsidy; it is a benefit limit, not an eligibility rule.
